column29: If the Claim Cost exceeds the Outlier Threshold, then the claim qualifies for a DRG outlier add-on payment. The Outlier Threshold is calculated as: Outlier Threshold = Unadjusted DRG Base Payment + Fixed Loss Amount. The Fixed Loss Amount is $5,000 for Critical Access Hospitals (CAH) and $65,000 for all other providers. For claims that qualify, the Unadjusted DRG Outlier Add-on Payment will be calculated as: Unadjusted DRG Outlier Add-on Payment = [Claim Cost – Outlier Threshold] * DRG Marginal Cost Percentage. The DRG Marginal Cost Percentage is 90% for burn DRGs and 80% for all other DRGs. Additionally, qualifying administrative days are paid at per diems when billed separately from acute services.
